messages:
maria (infosec): Heads-up: Compliance will tighten egress defaults in eu-west-1 Tue 02:00 UTC. This blocks some legacy outbound endpoints used by GPU onboarding and may prevent ephemeral KMS grants.

sam (platform): Which endpoints are impacted? Can we get an allowlist? :thinking_face:

maria (infosec): Targets non-approved outbound IPs. Affected names: keystore.internal.redwood, bootstrap-shard-3.redwood, old-telemetry.redwood. Rule id: fw-eu-2026-07.

raj (infra): Reproduced in staging: new nodes show `keystore handshake timeout` then `failed to obtain ephemeral-key`. Example log: `2026-03-11T08:22:10Z node-23 ERROR: keystore handshake failed: tcp timeout` -> fallback to cached grant -> degraded warmup.

kevin (oncall): Warm-pool in staging dropped 85% -> 40% within ~6m when the rule applied. Token reuse went up due to cache fallback.

jen (sre): Short-term idea: request a scoped audit-exception for the bootstrap path only. Keeps audit trail but allows traffic. Long-term: route keystore traffic via approved proxy CIDR.

maria (infosec): Compliance can approve a scoped exception if we provide exact IPs/domains, a timebox (<=48h) and bump audit retention to 180d. Need list + justification by EOD.

sam (platform): Proposal for exception: keystore.internal.redwood:443, bootstrap-shard-*.redwood:443, and 10.200.4.0/24 (edge proxy). I'll open a PR to git.redwood/fw-regions with ACL diff.

raj (infra): We'll canary the exception AZ-by-AZ. Toggle script: `./ops/node-onboard --region eu-west-1 --az a --canary on`.

kevin (oncall): I'll monitor `gpu_warmpool_fill` and `keystore_handshake_5xx`. Rollback criteria: warm-pool drop >20% or keystore 5xx spike.

maria (infosec): audit-bot, please create a ticket documenting the firewall change, approvers, and retention delta.

audit-bot: Created ticket AUD-2026-331 "Scoped egress exception for GPU onboarding (eu-west-1)" assigned to maria (infosec), sam (platform).

jen (sre): PR checklist: include a smoke test `curl -sSf https://keystore.internal.redwood/health` from a fresh node and a runbook snippet to revoke the exception: `./infra/fwctl apply --rule-id fw-eu-2026-07 --remove-exception onboarders`.

sam (platform): PR posted with smoke test and canary steps, tagging @maria for approval.

maria (infosec): Approved for 24h exception. Retention increased. Require post-mortem on reliance on legacy endpoints. :white_check_mark:

raj (infra): Will schedule node backfills 30m after PR merges. Paging hooks set.

kevin (oncall): Oncall will watch the channel and post metric summaries. Ping if warm-pool falls or keystore errors exceed 1% for 5m.

maria (infosec): Target: remove exception within 24h and deliver proxy routing in next sprint.

sam (platform): Merging PR now. :rocket:
